text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The sunlight's getting to my eyes 
and making me dizzy~
choice_data_list: Are you feeling unwell or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No... It's just, there's a child we're 
temporarily looking after at my parents' 
house...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"She wakes up night after night, and for 
some reason she won't go back to sleep 
unless she talks with me."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So, I called you over and over in the 
middle of the night...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... I feel like I'm gonna fall asleep 
like this...

Even after that, Super Creek continued to 
yawn, looking as sleepy as ever...
